documents.title: Concentrated positions under a trading plan

passages.text: Where a trading plan is in place, a single position above the household threshold may be carried. The plan is the mitigation, and no further action is required until it completes.

claims.value: yes: the plan is the mitigation and no further action is required

passages.text: Concentration above a household's policy threshold can be reduced through staged sales under an existing trading plan, an exchange fund, or hedging, each with different tax and liquidity costs.
Staged sales that realise short-term gains carry a higher tax cost than sales of lots held longer than one year.
A trading plan on its own does not restore a household to its policy threshold. It schedules sales, and the position stays above policy until they complete.

claims.value: no: a trading plan schedules sales and the breach stands until they complete

documents.title: Non-US pooled funds held by US taxpayers

passages.text: Holdings in non-US pooled funds may be classified as PFICs for US taxpayers, with punitive default tax treatment unless an election is made.
This note describes options for discussion. It is not a projection of future performance and not a recommendation until reviewed with your advisor.
Contributors receive units in a diversified partnership. A seven-year holding period applies before a diversified basket may be distributed.
A Liquidity strategy is sized to cover one to three years of planned spending in cash and short-dated instruments.

claims.value: one to three years of planned spending

passages.text: A Liquidity strategy is sized to cover two to five years of planned spending, held in instruments that do not require selling risk assets during a drawdown.

claims.value: two to five years of planned spending

passages.text: Where a Liquidity strategy is unfunded, new cash inflows are the lowest-cost source of funding because no position has to be sold.
A municipal ladder provides tax-exempt income with scheduled maturities for high-bracket households.
Unsigned account documents older than 14 days are escalated to the branch supervisor.
Client information is refreshed on a 36-month cycle or on a material life event.
Laddered US Treasuries mature on a schedule matched to planned withdrawals. Market value can move before maturity; held to maturity, principal is returned at par.
